heading: JEE Main 2027 from January 22, UGC-NET from December 14
paragraphs: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released its examination calendar for the December 2026 to March 2027 cycle, covering several major entrance and eligibility tests, through its official website, nta.ac.in. As per the tentative schedule, the December UGC-NET will be held from December 14 to 19, while the Joint CSIR-UGC NET is scheduled for December 20 and 21.
The Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 session 1 is proposed from January 22 to 24 and January 28 to 30. CUET PG 2027 is scheduled across multiple dates between March 1 and 25.

The UGC-NET December cycle will have two additional buffer days, December 20 and 21, while the JEE Main Session 1 calendar has January 31 as a buffer date. NTA has also scheduled the NIFT Entrance Examination for January 10 and the All India Sainik Schools Entrance Examination for January 31. Candidates can find the complete schedule as released on the official website below:

Note that NTA has mentioned that the exam dates are tentative and may change due to administrative, academic, statutory, logistical or other unforeseen circumstances.
NTA will conduct the Common Management Admission Test (CMAT) on February 7, followed by the NITTT Part 1 examination on February 26 and 27.

The March calendar includes CUET PG, which is proposed to be conducted on March 1–5, March 8, March 12–20 and March 24–25, with March 30 and 31 kept as buffer dates. NITTT Part 2 is scheduled for March 5 and 7.

The agency will separately release detailed notification and applications for the above-mentioned exams. Candidates appearing for any of these exams are required to regularly check the official website of NTA for more such updates.
